title: Sable and the Playlist
author: Sebastian Voss
blurb: Tamsin Winterbourne, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
